items.title: Winard Harper interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 10, 2014

ctx.x: of those guys didn’t like each other which is kind of amazing. Because if that was the case, then that too says that look, they understood that even if that was the case, you had some problem with somebody, when they got on the bandstand, that bandstand was sacred. We’re going to take care of business. We’re going to spread the love, and this is the thread that’s going to tie us all together. So that’s a great thing. Music is powerful. I remember one time too, maybe Frank Wess told me this story and then I think…
